title: Eng Water Overheat
detail_of_failure: The engine controller senses engine coolant temperature overheat (105℃ or above) when voltage from the engine coolant temperature sensor decreases while the engine is running.
controller_action: • Lights up the engine coolant temperature caution lamp in red on the machine monitor. • Operates the machine with the engine output limited.
machine_effect: • If the machine continues to be used, the engine can be seized. • Engine output is reduced.
related_information: • The engine controller transmits the inputted signal voltage of the engine coolant temperature sensor to the machine monitor by CAN communication. • Engine coolant temperature can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 04107) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.cause: Overheating of engine coolant (when system is normal)
steps.procedure: Lowered engine oil pressure can be the cause. Check it and if oil pressure is lowered, repair to clear the cause of failure. • For details, see “Coolant Temperature Increases Too High (Overheat)” in S-mode.

steps.cause: Defective engine coolant temperature sensor system
steps.procedure: If no failure is found by the check on cause 1, the engine coolant temperature sensor system can be defective. Do the troubleshooting for failure codes [CA144] and [CA145].

default_conclusion: Defective engine coolant temperature sensor system
